title: Bitar kafofin watsa labarun ku, adana shi, kuma ku tsara kwanaki 90 na gaba
course_title: Bayanan Murya, Hotuna & Bidiyo don Bayyanawa

say: Bitar kafofin watsa labarun ku, adana shi, kuma ku tsara kwanaki 90 na gaba.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfura huɗu na Bayanan kula na Murya, Hotuna da Bidiyo don Bayyanawa.
Yawancin mutane suna aika saƙo kuma ba za su sake tunani game da shi ba. Kuna inganta da sauri ta hanyar duba aikinku tare da ƴan bayyanannun tambayoyi.

say: Kowane tsari yana da cak guda uku. Rubutun murya yana sanya babban batu a cikin daƙiƙa goma na farko, ba shi da hayaniya mai rufe kalmomi, kuma ya rubuta lambar maɓalli a ƙasa. Hoto yana da kaifi kuma yana nuna dalla-dalla. Bidiyo yana ƙasa da mintuna biyu, tsaye kuma ana iya ji.

say: Yi maki kowane cak 0, 1 ko 2, don maki cikin 6. Kada ku yi nufin 6 a rana ɗaya. Nufin haɓaka maki na yau da kullun da maki ɗaya a cikin 'yan makonni.

say: Misali, Aisha a Kano tana aika menu na bayanin murya na mako-mako ga kwastomomi 25 na yau da kullun. A cikin mako na 1, bayaninta shine 2 mintuna 10, tare da farashin magana kawai. Ta kirga tambayoyin bibiya guda 9.

Hoto ɗaya na babban tasa: 2 tambayoyi

panel.rule: Canja abu ɗaya kawai a lokaci guda, kuma rubuta shi.

say: Masu sana'a suna amfani da ka'ida mai suna 3-2-1: kwafi uku, akan nau'ikan ajiya guda biyu, tare da kwafi ɗaya a wani wuri dabam. Kwafin farko shine na asali akan wayarka.

panel.heading: Ra'ayin 3-2-1, an yi shi mai sauƙi

cards.d: Kwafin da kuke ɗauka kowace rana. Ana iya ɓacewa, sata ko jefawa cikin ruwa.
Hotunan Google ko Google Drive. Kunna madadin, akan Wi-Fi kawai idan bayanai suna da tsada.
Don fayiloli mafi daraja: kwamfuta ko katin ƙwaƙwalwa a gida ko tare da amintaccen dangi.

say: Na biyu yana cikin gajimare. A cikin Hotunan Google, matsa hoton bayanin ku, buɗe saitunan Hotuna, nemo Ajiyayyen kuma kunna shi. Asusun Google kyauta ya ƙunshi 15 GB, wanda aka raba tare da Gmail da Drive.

say: Misali, Esther a Jos tana da asusun Google kyauta, kuma Gmail da Drive sun riga sun yi amfani da 2 GB. Wannan ya bar 13 GB, kusan 13,000 MB.

panel.heading: Esther ta duba kafin ta ja baya
items: Hagu sarari: 15 GB debe 2 GB = 13 GB
Hotuna: 3,000 x 3 MB = 9,000 MB
Bidiyo: kusan 6,000 MB. Jimlar 15,000 MB
Ya yi yawa: share kwafi, sa'an nan kuma ajiye
